content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSDS Information Technology Krishna School of Diploma Studies builds strong IT fundamentals through practical laboratories, ethical professional values, and industry-connected learning. 0 Established 0 Core Faculty 0 Computer Labs 0 Mission Goals LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSDS Ms. Komal Kushwaha Head of Department, Information Technology hod.it.ksds@kpgu.ac.in I warmly welcome all the students & their parents to the Department of Information Technology. Information Technology is the essence of today's world. The Department strives to combine excellence in education with meaningful service to the industry. Our vision is to be recognized as an innovative and leading Information Technology Department. Our goal is to provide students with a balance of intellectual and practical experiences that enable them to serve a variety of societal needs. In our department students are nurtured to become excellent software professionals, Project Managers, System Analysts or Team leaders in Industry, Entrepreneurs with innovative ideas. I am sure in times to come; many students from our department will make indelible mark nationally and internationally in the field of Information Technology and make us proud. ABOUT DEPARTMENT IT Education With Industry Alignment 01 After successful creating Computer Engineers for the last 17 years at Babaria Institute of Technology we have now entered  the field of Information technology education under our Global University. The Department of Information Technology was established in the year 2020 with the objective of imparting knowledge in cutting-edge technologies in Information Technology. 02 The Department has a team of dynamic, young and dedicated faculty members, with expertise in a wide range of areas. The Department has well equipped laboratories with facilities that are essential for training the students in state-of-art software and hardware technologies. Centrally air-conditioned laboratories equipped with high configuration computers and servers, supported by licensed software, high speed internet connectivity through fibre optics on leased line and Wi-Fi facilities. 03 Technical education provides the brainpower reavired to drive the value adding processes of the nation. Technology acts as a vehicle for development and contributes to the transformation of material and other resources into value added products and services, thereby enhancing quality of life of people. The key driver of growth is techno-scientific and managerial work force. This human resource provides the greatest advantage provided that the brainpower is developed to its fullest potential, both in quantity and quality. The quality of brainpower is one of the most important resources. 04 The Department continuously strives to introduce the latest technologies and advancements to the young learners and aspirants by inviting the corporate legends and experienced academicians to enlighten the Information Technology community of our institution. 05 We focus on skill development of students and faculty members by inviting industry experts to deliver expert talks, organizing competitions and workshops and signing MOUs and collaborations with leading industries. 06 To bridge the gap between educational institutions & IT industry the department aims to introduce advanced and emerging courses and meet the growing demands of industries. The rapidly growing department of Information technology is committed to providing knowledge in emerging areas and strives to work towards the vision of the institute. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision The department of Information Technology envisage to prepare technically competent and skilled intellectual IT professionals for a globalised technological society. 01 To provide state of art infrastructure for implementing effective and an efficient teaching learning process. 02 To impart quality education in the field of Information Technology for preparing students to solve challenging real-world problems. 03 To prepare students for successful careers based on Strong Moral and Ethical foundation.
